title: Imaging Studies With GE C-Hawk Gamma Camera Compared to Routine Clinical Exam
brief_summary: Comparison study of myocardial perfusion SPECT imaging with current clinical use camera and new camera.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Referral for cardiac stress testing with SPECT myocardial perfusion imaging

Exclusion Criteria:

* refusal to provide written informed consent or lack capacity to provide informed consent
study_population: Adults undergoing SPECT Myocardial perfusion imaging
